findings.summary: Since previous_defs now holds Line objects instead of depths, the condition `self.previous_defs[-1]` is always truthy, so it no longer filters on indentation; a top-level def followed by a depth-0 line like `else:` now gets 1 blank line instead of 2 in non-pyi mode, changing default output (fix: use `self.previous_defs[-1].depth`).
